title: Time Travel
text: Excellent tour with very comfortable bud and extremely knowledgeable guides. Lots of history and amazing views.
author: 274nasark

title: Beautiful experience
text: The tour itself was amazing. Our guide Petra, our driver and the guide at the Alhambra Juan were amazing. During the long drive they constantly inform you with fun facts about the city, however there is also time to rest. The bus is very comfortable, and the driver stops halfway so everyone is able to get something to drink or go to the toilet. The Alhambra is definitely a must stop when sight seeing and our guide Juan made the experience even better with his enthusiasm and gives everyone time to take pictures and video’s.
author: Etherealjourneys

title: Seville to Granada day trip
text: It was an amazing trip. Our tour conductor Petra kept us entertained through out the journey. Out tour guide was Carlos excellent guide with great knowledge of Al Hambra .
author: aftab57

title: Superb day
text:
I recommend the tour, unavoidable, superb day with very friendly, kind and listening companion. 
We chose to visit the cathedral at lunchtime to have time to see Granada in addition to the sights visited.
author: V2077SAsandriner

title: A very well informed tour of a beautiful location
text:
Given the commuting time from Seville to Grenada, this is an early starting tour. Our tour guide (Abby) and driver (Jesus) picked us up from the pre arranged hotel pick up point and everything kick started on time. 

As we all began to slowly wake up after the pit stop, Abby began to give us a very interesting historical guide of Granada and Andalusia as a whole. You can tell she is very passionate about the appreciation of the history of the area and this made it more interesting to listen to and take in.

author: Morad N

title: Very interesting trip and visit.
text:
Very interesting but a little too long for me. 
If possible, you may offer to the group the possibility to have a less long visit.
author: moussadake

title: This was a great trip, having the...
text: This was a great trip, having the extra day in Granada was the best to be able to explore and enjoy time on our own in this wonderful city. The main complaint was disorganization. Once at the Ahambra Palace if you did not watch close you could easily lose your group prior to the tour even starting. After the tour the time spent locating and finding the ride back on the bus again was very disorganized and confusing. author: mj

title: Whilst we've rated the tour highly...
text: Whilst we've rated the tour highly (which is mainly due to the fact of the beautiful location and activities) the tour company was disorganised. Our pick up time in Seville wasn't confirmed with us, they didn't arrange our paper work with the hotel so the hotel in Granada and the hotel staff argued with us wanting payment, or confirmation of booking that was never provided to us bynthe tour company, and to top it off the tour company forgot to pick us up to take us back to Seville.
author: Mandana C
